item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Your day's already stacked with check-ins, movement, and wind-down routines — medication is the one that keeps all of that working the way it's supposed to. Don't let it get crowded out by the schedule. Take it at the right time, not whenever you remember. One action: set a fixed time for it right now, before the day gets away from you.
